why_this_record_exists: Two earlier partners were killed at 5 h and left NOTHING, because a row is appended only when a partner search returns. The heartbeat added to teichner_certify.py writes the knot, partner, sum crossing number and start time before the long call. This file is that heartbeat surviving its kill, which is the behaviour the patch was for.
budget_guidance: Cost is grossly superlinear in the crossing number of the sum: 4.21 h at 31, 7.96 h at 33, and more than 12 h at 35 for BOTH 35-crossing partners tried. Roughly a doubling per two crossings. 10_3, 10_22 and 10_87 are now running at 24 h budgets. Do not extrapolate linearly.

fibered_partners_excluded: 8_9, 8_20 and 9_27 are fibered and give 33 to 34 crossing sums, so they look cheap. They are futile and should not be run. Adding a fibered ribbon J leaves K_0 and -K_1 still unpaired among the fibered prime summands, so Miyazaki continues to give non-ribbon for the sum and no ribbon certificate can exist. The restriction in teichner_certify.py is therefore well founded; its comment that fiberedness alone does not apply Miyazaki is about checking hypotheses, not a live gap.
